scope_fields.review_status: Scoped partial results accepted by the accompanying independent AI-assisted mathematical audit; unrefereed
accepted_results: Cubic reduced-degree congruence m = 1 mod 3 and exact homogeneous Jacobian power
Nonambient reduced cubic degree is at least four; the cubic is the sole contracted divisor
A degree-four map cannot contract a smooth cubic to a point; the transverse valuation for a curve center is one
For reduced degree four in P3 the inverse degree belongs to [4,7,10,13,16]
Complete extension and classification for pointwise line-projection kernels on smooth cubic complements
Nonzero square coefficient and complete pointwise natural double-cover kernels for the two Du Val weighted families
Necessary and sufficient finite polynomial identities for each proposed nonambient cubic-complement automorphism, with primitive normalization
Explicit plane, normal-quadric, E6 cubic, and Fermat controls
claim_limits: Exact fixed ordinary and weighted ambient models
Projection bases are fixed pointwise in the kernel theorems
No theorem of arbitrary complement-automorphism extension or pencil preservation
No bound on all complement-automorphism degrees
No infeasibility proof for the nonlinear certificate systems
The E6 example has a polar cylinder and is not a counterexample to the equivalence
No novelty, priority, exhaustive literature, worldwide current openness, external human peer review or journal acceptance claim

reason: Actual PR body, README and STATUS explicitly leave the full cylinder-free/all-automorphism-extension equivalence unresolved. Exact cubic degree congruence/Jacobian and degree-four center restrictions do not classify arbitrary complement automorphisms. The inverse-degree list4/7/10/13/16 is conditional on forward degree4, not a global bound. Ambient extension/classification only for pointwise fixed line/double-cover projection kernels; preservation of any projection or pencil by arbitrary maps remains unproved. Finite necessary/sufficient identities certify a proposed map, not infeasibility of all nonlinear certificate degrees. Fixed ordinary/weighted ambient models and polynomial versus anticanonical degree retained. E6 example has a polar cylinder and does not refute the equivalence. Prior inputs credited, no novelty or full solution.
